# Lightwave: MDU Broadband Expands Beyond Connectivity


Sean Buckley of Lightwave highlights how Alan DiCicco, VP of Solution and Product Marketing at Calix, sees MDU broadband evolving from a connectivity service into a foundation for better resident and property experiences. DiCicco notes that bulk internet has become a valuable amenity for residents, while integrated broadband, managed Wi-Fi, and smart property technologies can help property owners reduce costs, improve operations, and deliver a more seamless experience across the entire community.
